title: Transfer roundup: West Brom reject Burnley’s £16m bid for Jay Rodriguez
trail: West Brom have turned down a second bid for the striker Jay Rodriguez from his former club Burnley
body: West Bromwich Albion have rejected a £16m offer from Burnley for Jay Rodriguez. The bid fell well short of West Brom’s valuation of the striker, who is not agitating for a move. The Championship side want to keep hold of Rodriguez as they seek an instant return to the Premier League. West Brom have already turned down a joint £25m offer for Rodriguez and Craig Dawson, with the club wanting at least £20m for each player. Burnley must now weigh up whether to return with a third bid as their manager, Sean Dyche, chases reinforcements at Turf Moor. Rodriguez initially left Burnley for Southampton in 2012 in a deal worth around £7m and moved to the Hawthorns last summer for £12m. He scored 11 goals in all competitions but could not keep West Brom in the Premier League. Bournemouth were also interested in the striker but their interest appears to have cooled having tied down Callum Wilson to a new contract. West Brom, who host Bolton in their Championship opener on Saturday, have already lost Jonny Evans and Ben Foster following their relegation. Nacer Chadli, Salomón Rondón and Dawson could also go before the transfer window closes next Thursday. Abdoulaye Doucouré has signed a new five-year contract with Watford after excelling last season. The Frenchman has committed his future to the club until 2023 having joined from Rennes in 2016.
